question: Which item IDs in the bounded building-definition block have exact stored identities, tokens, descriptions, and signed production factors?

scope.boundary: Twenty-three exact initialized records are mapped. The cost helper accepts IDs 100 through 199; this packet does not establish a safe validity guard for IDs 123 through 199, complete fields, final costs, text consumers, implemented effects, or runtime behavior.

dependencies.use: Provides ID-minus-100 selection, stride, signed +0x41 factor and cost lookup.
Provides three independently accepted building identities and UEA-specific half-cost branches.

fields.meaning: Exact initialized identity text in each record; Palace and Bank are raw null-terminated bytes where Ghidra has no defined string.
Initialized token text at a repeated offset; consumer and meaning are unresolved.
Signed byte consumed by BuildingWonderProductionCostLookup before later modifiers; not final cost.
Initialized English description text; no implemented gameplay effect follows from this text alone.

boundaryEvidence.lastRecord: Item 122 occupies 0x82F73160 through 0x82F7322B; the last twelve bytes at 0x82F7322C through 0x82F73237 contain non-record words, followed by the accepted wonder table at 0x82F73238.
boundaryEvidence.qualification: The adjacent data and accepted wonder base prevent extending this contiguous 0xCC building-record block to a stride-derived item 123. They do not prove that every ID outside 100-122 is rejected by all callers.

currentEvidence.method: Sequential foreground read-only Ghidra queries of exactly the bounded building block, all twenty-three signed +0x41 cells, and three missing Ghidra string definitions; joined to the accepted exact cost helper.

entries.result: Sixty-four defined strings establish twenty-one record-base names, repeated tokens, and descriptions.
Exact words spell Palace and Bank at record bases and Bank, Mine, and SDI at token offsets not defined as strings.
Twenty-three exact words at +0x41 expose the leading signed factor bytes recorded for each ID.
The next stride-derived start is non-record data twelve bytes before the accepted wonder-table base.

currentEvidence.qualification: Static image data and accepted helper establish record contents and factor consumption only. No runtime probe was performed.

guards: Do not interpret the descriptions as implemented effects or proved UI output.
Do not infer a matching asset, asset ownership, or token meaning from repeated or mismatched text.
Do not treat signed factors as final production costs.
Do not treat the helper range 100 through 199 as twenty-three-plus validated definitions.
Do not name adjacent fields or claim complete modifier, producer, completion, AI, persistence, or runtime coverage.
conclusion: The supported image has twenty-three exact initialized building records at IDs 100 through 122, each with stored name, token, description, and signed +0x41 production factor. The next stride-derived address overlaps adjacent non-record data before the wonder table. The broader cost-helper range remains unsafe as a valid-definition rule.
